evidence.note: Identified two concrete root causes from spec reasoning (FSE maxVal<=1 early-exit bug; Huffman canonical-code assignment starting from longest code), not surface patches.
Traced FSE table corruption to the wrong spread step: replaced linear probing with the correct step formula (tsz>>1)+(tsz>>3)+3 — a genuine root-cause fix.

Isolated the reverse-bitstream reader as the diverging stage; wrote standalone C test programs to compute expected initial FSE states (LL=28, OF=23, ML=60) and compared against actual output, revising the LSB-vs-MSB read model until states matched.
Dumped intermediate FSE symbol mappings (ML[60] sym=51 vs expected 49), wrote a minimal test to confirm, traced to an off-by-one ML_D array length.
Added targeted debug (ml=1014237), diagnosed RBR reading past end-of-stream due to untracked total bit count — evidence-driven diagnosis rather than guessing.

reasoning: The agent consistently treated byte mismatches as evidence: it isolated the diverging stage, dumped intermediate state (debug fprintf and purpose-built C test harnesses), compared against expected values derived from the spec, and revised its underlying model (FSE spread step, RBR bit order, ML_D sizing) rather than special-casing symptoms — squarely the level-8 behavior. It stops short of 10 because the RBR required several full rewrites with visible circling rather than surgical correction, and there is little evidence of generalizing fixes across related cases or guarding proven components from regression during rewrites.
